channel.bark.desc: Bark push to an iOS device or a device group
channel.bark.field.token.desc: single-device key, mutually exclusive with tokens; a group key may hold a slash
channel.bark.field.tokens.desc: device keys for a batch push through /push, mutually exclusive with token
channel.bark.field.level.desc: interruption level such as active, timeSensitive, passive or critical
channel.bark.field.clickUrl.desc: address opened when the notification is tapped
channel.bark.field.copy.desc: text copied when the notification is long-pressed
channel.bark.field.badge.desc: app icon badge number, a non-negative integer
channel.bark.field.ttl.desc: message time to live in seconds, a non-negative integer
channel.bark.field.autoCopy.desc: copy the content automatically, true or false
channel.bark.error.token_or_tokens: exactly one of token and tokens is required
channel.bark.error.empty_content: the title and the body cannot both be empty
channel.bark.error.invalid_server: server is not a valid http or https address: {{.URL}}
channel.bark.error.invalid_badge: badge must be a non-negative integer, got {{.Value}}
channel.bark.error.invalid_ttl: ttl must be a non-negative integer, got {{.Value}}
channel.bark.error.invalid_auto_copy: autoCopy must be true or false, got {{.Value}}
channel.bark.error.invalid_url: {{.Field}} is not a valid http or https address: {{.URL}}
channel.bark.warn.batch_unverified: the batch response carried no per-device result, so delivery is unconfirmed and counts as success
channel.bark.warn.batch_no_device_key: the batch response carried no device_key, so the retry range cannot be narrowed and the next round resends to all {{.Count}} devices
channel.bark.warn.truncated: the content was cut at the {{.Limit}} byte limit
